name: ethereum

usdc.verified: rpc: symbol USDC, 6 dec; address matches Circle's published native USDC (repo tests/utils/Constants.sol ETHEREUM_USDC)

release.chainlinkStaleRateThresholdNote: 172800s (48h) sized for the SLOWEST registered feed (global threshold, one immutable value per ValueInterpreter). Slowest = USDC/ETH: heartbeat 86400s, max observed gap 97800s. Just above the heartbeat (e.g. 90000s) would already have reverted valuation on the observed 97800s gap; 172800 = 2x heartbeat, 1.77x the max observed gap, so one missed heartbeat is tolerated. ETH/USD (heartbeat 3600s, max observed 15996s) is far inside it. Trade-off: too LOW a threshold reverts valid rates and freezes deposits/redeems/valuation (fails closed); too HIGH accepts stale prices, here up to 48h for the ETH/USD feed (heartbeat 1h) because the threshold is global. Accepted because the vault denomination is a USD stablecoin and the 0.5% deviation trigger keeps ETH/USD fresh in practice. Values re-checked 2026-10-01.
